summary: {chief} supports the governor's proposal and acknowledges disagreement within the association.
realLife: Newton's police chief told the council that the Massachusetts chiefs' association backed the pardon after internal disagreement.
gates: Association position, witness and evidence of dissent.
inGame: needs: association position, witness and evidence of dissent.

turns.pulledBy: A member calls the endorsement unanimous.
turns.what: Have the witness correct the description.
turns.writesBack: The minutes record support without claiming unanimity.

turns.pulledBy: A member asks how individual chiefs voted.
turns.what: Report only what the witness can establish.
turns.writesBack: The association's position stays distinct from individual views.
